author: Forbes
description:
The collective fortune of Chinese billionaires on Forbes’ annual World’s Billionaires list reached nearly $2.2 trillion in 2026 — close to the record $2.5 trillion set in 2021, before the pandemic and private-sector crackdowns decimated the market value of many technology giants. This year’s collective wealth is up 31% from $1.68 trillion in 2025, and $1.33 trillion two years ago.

Meanwhile, The ten richest Chinese citizens, are worth a collective $414.5 billion, up from $400.5 billion last year.

author: Forbes
description:
Is AI coming for… everything?

In 2026, artificial intelligence has moved from buzzword to backbone in almost every piece of consumer tech. But between the hype and the headlines, how much of it is actually useful?

Rebecca Isaacs, Forbes Vetted's consumer tech editor, breaks down five of the most interesting ways AI is showing up this year, from laptops that seamlessly talk to your phone to a Lego brick that literally listens to you.

Which of these AI features would you actually use? And are you grabbing those smart glasses or sticking with your “dumb” fridge?

Let us know in the comments.
